title: Most Adults Can’t Score 80% On This Memory Test
summary: Twelve focused challenges test words, pictures, numbers, order, associations and the details that disappear fastest.

landing.intro: Think your memory is still sharp? Some challenges are easy. Some are designed to catch you out. Can you score 80%?

startPrompt.title: Test Ready! 🎉
startPrompt.copy: Watch a short ad to start the test.

about.body:
This short memory test packs word recall, visual details, number memory, ordering, associations and close attention into one focused set of twelve questions. Some clues are tested immediately, while others return later when you may no longer expect them.

The challenge is designed to feel quick without becoming throwaway. Study cards disappear, earlier details return and the final question combines information from several moments in the test.

Your result shows the number answered correctly and the memory area that suited you best. Attention, tiredness and chance can affect performance, so treat the score as entertainment rather than a judgement about cognitive health.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Study every word, symbol, number and pairing carefully when it appears.
Choose one answer for each of the twelve questions before the test moves on.
Finish the single challenge to reveal your score and strongest memory area.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and self-reflection only. This test is not a medical, neurological or cognitive assessment and cannot diagnose memory problems.

profiles.title: Memory Mastermind
profiles.copy: You held onto immediate clues and delayed details with exceptional precision. Even the final combination struggled to catch you out.

profiles.title: Razor-Sharp Recall
profiles.copy: You cleared the 80% challenge with sharp attention and reliable recall. Most details stayed available exactly when you needed them.

profiles.title: Almost Unforgettable
profiles.copy: Your memory caught most of the test’s important clues. Only a few carefully delayed details slipped away.

profiles.title: Selective Genius
profiles.copy: You remembered a strong selection of words, images and patterns. Your mind clearly had favourites among the clues.

profiles.title: Memory With Opinions
profiles.copy: Some details stuck instantly while others disappeared on their own schedule. You still caught enough to keep the challenge close.

profiles.title: Beautifully Distracted
profiles.copy: This compact test found several ways to split your attention. You still rescued some excellent details from the noise.
